finding_summary: The Pump A closeout record (closeout-record-pump-a) cites evidence-0019-functional-checks in its evidence_ids field. That evidence record is bound to component pump-b (Pump B functional-check evidence, status accepted after Pump B obstruction-clearance intervention). The correct Pump A functional-check evidence is evidence-0000-functional-checks-pump-a, which is properly cited in condition-history-pump-a and provisional-return-record-pump-a but absent from the closeout record. This cross-component evidence citation means the closeout is supported by Pump B evidence rather than Pump A evidence and cannot be accepted as issued. Two additional inconsistencies require follow-up: (1) work-order-pump-a carries status in_progress while all other Pump A records declare scope completed, indicating the work order has not been formally closed; (2) restriction-0000-pump-a-run-in carries status lifted but its statement asserts the restriction remains active after verification, a direct internal contradiction that must be resolved before unrestricted return-to-service is confirmed.
required_follow_up: Correct the evidence_ids on closeout-record-pump-a: replace evidence-0019-functional-checks (pump-b) with evidence-0000-functional-checks-pump-a (pump-a) and reissue the closeout record.
Close work-order-pump-a: transition status from in_progress to completed or closed to reflect the declared scope completion before any further closeout attempt.

Resolve the contradiction on restriction-0000-pump-a-run-in: reconcile the statement ('remains active after verification') with the status ('lifted') and confirm the definitive restriction state in writing before unrestricted return-to-service is progressed.
